can_buy.title: Can Indian buyers buy?
can_buy.body_html: Indian buyers can generally buy property in Dubai in designated freehold areas, subject to current ownership rules, buyer documents, project status and payment checks. The best next step is to match budget, purchase route, district, property type and visa goal before reserving a unit.
can_buy.body_text: Indian buyers can generally buy property in Dubai in designated freehold areas, subject to current ownership rules, buyer documents, project status and payment checks.

items.title: 1. Define buyer goal and budget
items.text: Investment, relocation, rental income, Golden Visa, second home or capital preservation.

items.title: 2. Verify purchase route
items.text: Check if the buyer will visit Dubai, reserve remotely, use POA or complete steps through developer/advisor process.

items.title: 3. Prepare documents and payment route
items.text: Confirm passport, buyer forms, source-of-funds checks, payment route and developer/bank requirements.

items.title: 4. Reserve only after live checks
items.text: Check current availability, payment plan, project status, handover, fees and legal/admin steps.

items.title: Passport and buyer details
items.text: Usually the first layer for reservation and identity checks.

items.title: Proof of address / contact details
items.text: May be required depending on developer, bank or transaction process.

items.title: Payment source and transfer route
items.text: Important for compliance, banking and clean transaction flow.

items.title: POA / remote authorization if needed
items.text: Remote completion can require additional legal steps, depending on the route.

decision_cards.title: Model total cash exposure
decision_cards.text: Check down payment, DLD fees, transfer route, installments and currency movement before reserving.

decision_cards.title: Remote trust and verification
decision_cards.text: Origin buyers need clear checks for developer, project status, escrow, availability and documents.

decision_cards.title: Visa goal needs separate check
decision_cards.text: Do not assume eligibility; match property value, ownership structure and current visa criteria.

decision_cards.title: Origin + budget + goal
decision_cards.text: Primadom AI can map country-specific concerns into a Dubai property shortlist.

items.title: Dubai Hills Estate

items.text: Useful for central lifestyle, rental logic and globally recognizable locations.

items.title: JVC / Arjan / Meydan
items.text: Often relevant when budget, payment plan and entry point matter more than trophy address.

buyer_concerns.title: Buyer concerns
buyer_concerns.body: Country / Origin Buyer Pages should address the concerns that appear before project selection: whether the buyer can buy, how remote purchase works, documents, payment route, trusted verification, Golden Visa logic, taxes or home-country implications, and how to avoid buying only from marketing materials.

golden_visa.title: Golden Visa logic
golden_visa.body: Golden Visa intent should be treated as a separate eligibility check, not a marketing assumption. Primadom AI should verify property value, ownership structure, mortgage/payment status, current visa criteria and whether the buyer’s family scenario fits before presenting the visa angle.

items.question: Can Indian buyers buy property in Dubai?
items.answer: Indian buyers can generally buy property in Dubai in designated freehold areas, subject to current rules, project status, buyer documents and payment checks.

items.question: Can Indian buyers buy Dubai property remotely?
items.answer: Remote purchase may be possible depending on project, developer, documents, POA requirements, identity checks and payment route. Each case should be checked before reservation.

items.question: What documents should Indian buyers prepare?
items.answer: Typical checks may include passport, contact details, proof of address, payment source, buyer form, reservation documents and any developer or bank-specific requirements.

items.question: Can Primadom AI prepare a Dubai property shortlist?
items.answer: Yes. Primadom AI can compare budget, payment plan, remote purchase needs, district, property type, Golden Visa goal and risk profile to prepare a shortlist.

source_notes.body: Ownership rules, freehold area eligibility, remote purchase steps, documents, payment route, Golden Visa criteria, project status, availability and fees should be checked against UAE government guidance, Dubai Land Department materials, developer documents and Primadom live advisor updates before a buyer decision.
